svg.aria-label: Pipeline: show.json and a donor .wpj go into wpj_show.py, which validates and refuses unproven fields; then wpj_codec.py converts JSON to bytes with self-checked fidelity; then wpjlib.py rebuilds the TLV container and recomputes the SHA-1; the result is a new, auto-verified .wpj, which you and only you hand to WTOOLS or the W1.
svg.title: The show pipeline
